name: Nitro Boost Text Says 100,000%
description: Rewrites the Nitro Boost and Turbo-charged Engine skill descriptions to read 100,000% instead of 40% / 10%, so the tooltip matches what nitro-boost-100000pct actually does. Covers English, German, Spanish, French, Italian and Portuguese; Japanese, Chinese and Korean keep the stock wording.
author: KSFA

patches.description: Skill description text for EXPUP_01 and EXPUP_02
